migration_summary: Column type change that cannot be done as a metadata-only cast; table rewrite scans and rewrites every row while holding an ACCESS EXCLUSIVE lock.
migration_sql: ALTER TABLE users ALTER COLUMN phone TYPE TEXT USING phone::text;
schema_summary: users.phone previously a constrained varchar; rewrite to unbounded text.

risk_flags.message: TYPE change with USING often rewrites the table and dependent indexes.

risk_narrative: ALTER ... TYPE with a non-binary-compatible cast rewrites the heap and may rebuild indexes. Duration tracks table size like other rewrite mechanisms (STORED generated columns, NOT NULL defaults on older engines).
lessons_learned: Prefer add-new-column → backfill → swap for incompatible type changes. Test the USING expression on a shadow copy. Expect exclusive locks; do not schedule during peak traffic.
surprise_notes: Even when the logical change is 'just a type', the physical mechanism is a rewrite—retrieval should group it with backfills, not with nullable ADD COLUMN.
